title: Microplane Professional Series Kitchen Grater new Fine for Hard Cheese, Citrus Fruits, Garlic, Chili, Cinnamon and Nutmeg with Stainless Steel Blades - Made in USA
description:
About this item
All Stainless Steel Construction: Experience long-lasting performance with a grater that resists rust and corrosion, thanks to its high-quality stainless steel handle, blade, and frame, ensuring both durability and sleek design in your kitchen.
Updated Durable Handle: Grate comfortably and with confidence; the reinforced handle design offers a secure grip, reducing hand fatigue and enhancing safety and efficiency during extended use.
American-Made Surgical-Grade Blades: Benefit from precision grating with ultra-sharp, surgical-grade stainless steel blades engineered in the USA, which cut effortlessly through ingredients, saving you time and preserving the delicate flavors of your food.
Non-Slip End Piece for Increased Stability: Achieve perfect results every time without the worry of slippage; the grater's non-slip end piece secures it firmly in place, providing added control and safety during your food preparation.
Protective Cover for Safekeeping: Keep the blades sharp and storage safe; the included protective cover ensures that your grater's edge stays ready for action and your fingers stay protected from accidental nicks when reaching into your kitchen drawer.
